## For businesses in the Philippines

I'm Jomer “Jomz” Jorge. I build websites, booking systems, inventory tools and AI add-ons for carinderias, resorts, clinics and shops. You tell me what slows you down, I build the fix, and I stay to support it.

- **Business website**: A fast, mobile-first site your customers can find on Google and Facebook.
- **Booking & reservations**: Online bookings with GCash or Maya deposits and a simple owner dashboard.
- **Inventory & POS**: Track stock and daily sales for your store, carinderia or canteen.
- **AI assistant**: Auto-replies and a chat helper that answers customers in Tagalog, Bisaya or English.
- **Automation & reports**: Turn spreadsheets into reports and schedule your Facebook posts automatically.

## Experience

I'm Jomer “Jomz” Jorge, an Angular and Node engineer with enterprise cloud ERP experience at Infor and NestJS and Java microservices for Placester, a US real-estate SaaS. BS Information Technology, STI College Calamba.

### Infor PSSC

Software Engineer · Cloud ERP. Shipped reliable releases of a global, multi-tenant cloud ERP.

- Challenge: Every release reaches many customers at once, so a regression hits everyone.
- Built: Angular features with automated tests, plus validation and verification before each release.
- Result: Customers on released versions stayed supported, with work shipped alongside analysts and architects across time zones.
- Stack: Angular, TypeScript, Automated tests, GitLab
- Link: https://www.infor.com
- Product: Multi-tenant (Global cloud ERP for enterprise customers)
- Every release: Tested (Automated tests, validation and verification)
- Team: Across time zones (Delivered with analysts and architects)

### Placester Inc.

Software Engineer · US real-estate SaaS. Built the service that decides what every paying agent can use.

- Challenge: Billing, feature access and client WordPress sites lived in separate systems.
- Built: A NestJS entitlement service tied to Zuora subscriptions, and PHP bridges from WordPress to the core Java services.
- Result: A plan change in billing now changes what an agent or brokerage can use, without manual updates.
- Stack: NestJS, Zuora, Java / Spring Boot, WordPress API, AWS
- Link: https://placester.com
- Billing: Zuora (Subscriptions drive what each agent can use)
- Plan changes: Automatic (No manual updates to feature access)
- Market: US (Real-estate SaaS for agents and brokerages)

### Microbitworx Solution

Full-stack Engineer · Laguna. Gave a manufacturer live visibility of work in progress.

- Challenge: Local clients needed custom systems built, deployed and supported end to end.
- Built: A WIP tracking system, a service management system in CodeIgniter, and the Alpha Laboratory website.
- Result: Clients went live on their own servers, with staff trained by me and critical issues handled same day.
- Stack: PHP, CodeIgniter, C#, MySQL, WordPress
- Critical issues: Same day (Handled for every live client)
- Delivered: 3 systems (WIP tracking, service management, Alpha Laboratory site)
- Go-live: On-site (On client servers, with staff trained by me)

## Products and client work


### Thamara's Lechon & Carinderia

Client · Agusan del Sur. Showed the owners where their profit really comes from.

- Challenge: Lechon brought in the most sales, so it looked like the star of the business.
- Built: A 30-day income and expense review in plain Filipino, plus Facebook ad management and automated daily posts.
- Result: Carinderia and BBQ carry most of the profit. Casual Bisaya ad copy far outperformed generic English posts.
- Stack: Data analysis, Meta Ads, Buffer automation
- Reviewed: 30 days (Of income and expenses, explained in plain Filipino)
- Real profit driver: Carinderia + BBQ (Not lechon, the biggest seller)
- Best-performing ads: Casual Bisaya (Far outperformed generic English posts)

### SwiftStay

Founder · Rental marketplace. Lets transient-house owners take bookings with no credit card required.

- Challenge: Most Filipino guests pay by e-wallet, and big platforms take a cut of every night.
- Built: A booking platform with GCash, Maya, QRPh and GrabPay checkout, and iCal sync with Airbnb and Booking.com.
- Result: Owners keep 100% of their nightly rate and see fewer double-bookings across channels.
- Stack: Angular, Cloudflare, E-wallet payments, iCal
- Link: https://swiftstay.uk
- Owner keeps: 100% (Of the nightly rate, no platform cut)
- Checkout: E-wallets (GCash, Maya, QRPh and GrabPay, no credit card)
- Calendar sync: iCal (With Airbnb and Booking.com, fewer double-bookings)

### Benepisyo

Free civic app · Calamba pilot. Helps everyday Filipinos find the government benefits they already qualify for.

- Challenge: Seniors, PWDs and solo parents miss national and LGU benefits because the information is scattered.
- What I'm building: A free, Tagalog-first web app covering all 1,642 cities and municipalities, with amounts, requirements and the source behind every benefit. Fully verified for Calamba first.
- Goal: Anyone can see what they're entitled to in a few taps, at no cost.
- Stack: Angular, Ant Design, Cloudflare Workers, D1
- Link: https://jjorge1999.github.io/benepisyo/
- Coverage: 1,642 (Cities and municipalities in the Philippines)
- Cost to users: Free (Tagalog-first, with the source behind every benefit)
- Pilot: Calamba (Fully verified first)
